        "\n",
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",

        "\n",

        "\n",
        "print(df.head())\n",
        "print(df.columns.tolist())\n"

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Select only Lung and Breast samples\n",
        "df_two = df[df[\"primary_site\"].isin([\"Lung\", \"Breast\"])]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Select all integrin genes\n",
        "genes = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith(\"ITG\")]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Reshape the data for plotting\n",
        "df_long = df_two.melt(\n",
        "    id_vars=\"primary_site\",\n",
        "    value_vars=genes,\n",
        "    var_name=\"Gene\",\n",
        "    value_name=\"Expression\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create violin plots\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(18, 8))\n",
        "\n",
        "sns.violinplot(\n",
        "    data=df_long,\n",
        "    x=\"Gene\",\n",
        "    y=\"Expression\",\n",
        "    hue=\"primary_site\",\n",
        "    split=True,\n",
        "    inner=\"quart\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.xticks(rotation=90)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Integrin Gene Expression: Lung vs Breast\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Integrin Genes\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Gene Expression\")\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {

    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "### Part 1 — Visual Exploration: Interpretation\n",
        "\n",
        "Based on the violin plots and separation scores, ITGAX appeared to be the strongest predictor for distinguishing lung and breast tissues, with a separation score of 3.2305. This suggests that ITGAX expression differs substantially between the two tissues, making it easier to distinguish them. On the other hand, ITGAE appeared to be the weakest predictor, with a separation score of 0.0309. Its expression levels showed substantial overlap between lung and breast tissues, making it difficult to distinguish them using this gene alone."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "wdiA2jF46fry"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Compare gene expression between Lung and Breast\n",
        "results = []\n",
        "\n",
        "for gene in genes:\n",
        "    lung = df_two[df_two[\"primary_site\"] == \"Lung\"][gene].dropna()\n",
        "    breast = df_two[df_two[\"primary_site\"] == \"Breast\"][gene].dropna()\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Standardized difference between the two groups\n",
        "    difference = abs(lung.mean() - breast.mean())\n",
        "    pooled_sd = np.sqrt((lung.var() + breast.var()) / 2)\n",
        "\n",
        "    score = difference / pooled_sd if pooled_sd > 0 else np.nan\n",
        "\n",
        "    results.append([gene, score])\n",
        "\n",
        "comparison = pd.DataFrame(\n",
        "    results,\n",
        "    columns=[\"Gene\", \"Separation Score\"]\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "comparison = comparison.sort_values(\n",
        "    \"Separation Score\", ascending=False\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(comparison.to_string(index=False))\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import (\n",
        "    accuracy_score, confusion_matrix,\n",
        "    ConfusionMatrixDisplay, roc_curve, roc_auc_score\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Select our strongest predictor\n",
        "strong_gene = \"ITGAX\"\n",
        "\n",
        "data = df_two[[strong_gene, \"primary_site\"]].dropna()\n",
        "\n",
        "X = data[[strong_gene]]\n",
        "y = (data[\"primary_site\"] == \"Lung\").astype(int)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Split data: 70% training, 30% testing\n",
        "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
        "    X, y, test_size=0.30,\n",
        "    random_state=42, stratify=y\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Train logistic regression model\n",
        "model = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)\n",
        "model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Make predictions\n",
        "y_pred = model.predict(X_test)\n",
        "y_prob = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate accuracy and AUC\n",
        "accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)\n",
        "auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Strong Predictor:\", strong_gene)\n",
        "print(\"Accuracy:\", round(accuracy, 4))\n",
        "print(\"AUC Score:\", round(auc, 4))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Confusion Matrix\n",
        "ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_predictions(\n",
        "    y_test, y_pred,\n",
        "    display_labels=[\"Breast\", \"Lung\"],\n",
        "    cmap=\"Blues\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Confusion Matrix - ITGAX\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# ROC Curve\n",
        "fpr, tpr, thresholds = roc_curve(y_test, y_prob)\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))\n",
        "plt.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f\"AUC = {auc:.3f}\")\n",
        "plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], \"--\", color=\"gray\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"False Positive Rate\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"True Positive Rate\")\n",
        "plt.title(\"ROC Curve - ITGAX\")\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",
        "plt.show()\n"
      ],
      "metadata": {

      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "source": [
        "### Part 3 — Weak Predictor: Interpretation\n",
        "\n",
        "The logistic regression model using ITGAE performed significantly worse than the model using ITGAX. ITGAE achieved an accuracy of 60.99% and an AUC score of 0.578, compared to ITGAX, which achieved 97.16% accuracy and an AUC score of 0.9834. The confusion matrix showed that ITGAE incorrectly classified all 54 breast samples as lung tissue, while correctly identifying 86 out of 87 lung samples. This suggests that ITGAE is a weak predictor because its expression levels do not provide enough information to reliably distinguish between lung and breast tissues. The results also demonstrate that accuracy alone can be misleading, especially when one tissue type is more common in the dataset."
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "SzblSYoe7MfQ"
      }
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Part 4: Model Stability\n",
        "\n",
        "# Use ITGAX with a different random state\n",
        "X_train2, X_test2, y_train2, y_test2 = train_test_split(\n",
        "    X, y,\n",
        "    test_size=0.30,\n",
        "    random_state=21,\n",
        "    stratify=y\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Train the new model\n",
        "model2 = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)\n",
        "model2.fit(X_train2, y_train2)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Make predictions\n",
        "y_pred2 = model2.predict(X_test2)\n",
        "y_prob2 = model2.predict_proba(X_test2)[:, 1]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate results\n",
        "accuracy2 = accuracy_score(y_test2, y_pred2)\n",
        "auc2 = roc_auc_score(y_test2, y_prob2)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Part 4: Model Stability\")\n",
        "print(\"------------------------\")\n",
        "print(\"Original Random State: 42\")\n",
        "print(\"Original Accuracy:\", round(accuracy, 4))\n",
        "print(\"Original AUC:\", round(auc, 4))\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nNew Random State: 21\")\n",
        "print(\"New Accuracy:\", round(accuracy2, 4))\n",
        "print(\"New AUC:\", round(auc2, 4))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Confusion matrix for new model\n",
        "ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_predictions(\n",
        "    y_test2, y_pred2,\n",
        "    display_labels=[\"Breast\", \"Lung\"],\n",
        "    cmap=\"Blues\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Confusion Matrix - ITGAX (Random State 21)\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n"
      ],

      "source": [
        "### Part 4 — Model Stability: Interpretation\n",
        "\n",
        "After changing the random state from 42 to 21, the model's accuracy increased from 97.16% to 98.58%, while the AUC score increased from 0.9834 to 0.9974. The new confusion matrix showed that 139 out of 141 samples were correctly classified, compared to 137 in the original model. Although there was a slight improvement, both models performed very well. However, additional testing with different random states would be needed to further evaluate its reliability."

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "\n",
        "# Part 5: Multi-Class Logistic Regression\n",
        "\n",
        "from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline\n",
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import classification_report\n",
        "\n",
        "# Select two integrin genes\n",
        "selected_genes = [\"ITGAX\", \"ITGA8\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Prepare data for all seven organs\n",
        "df_multi = df[[\"primary_site\"] + selected_genes].dropna()\n",
        "\n",
        "X_multi = df_multi[selected_genes]\n",
        "y_multi = df_multi[\"primary_site\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Organs:\", y_multi.unique())\n",
        "print(\"Number of organs:\", y_multi.nunique())\n",
        "\n",
        "# 70/30 train-test split\n",
        "X_train_m, X_test_m, y_train_m, y_test_m = train_test_split(\n",
        "    X_multi, y_multi,\n",
        "    test_size=0.30,\n",
        "    random_state=42,\n",
        "    stratify=y_multi\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Train logistic regression model\n",
        "model_multi = make_pipeline(\n",
        "    StandardScaler(),\n",
        "    LogisticRegression(max_iter=2000)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "model_multi.fit(X_train_m, y_train_m)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Predict organ type\n",
        "y_pred_m = model_multi.predict(X_test_m)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Calculate accuracy\n",
        "accuracy_m = accuracy_score(y_test_m, y_pred_m)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nMulti-Class Accuracy:\", round(accuracy_m, 4))\n",
        "print(\"\\nClassification Report:\")\n",
        "print(classification_report(y_test_m, y_pred_m))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create 7x7 confusion matrix\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))\n",
        "\n",
        "ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_predictions(\n",
        "    y_test_m,\n",
        "    y_pred_m,\n",
        "    cmap=\"Blues\",\n",
        "    xticks_rotation=45\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",

        "### Part 5 — Multi-Class Classification: Interpretation\n",
        "\n",
        "The multi-class logistic regression model achieved an overall accuracy of approximately 78.1% when predicting seven different organ types using ITGAX and ITGA8. The model performed particularly well when identifying lung and brain tissues, with accuracies of 98.9% and 96.5%, respectively. However, it struggled to identify breast, liver, and ovary tissues, frequently misclassifying them as brain. This may be because some tissues have similar integrin expression levels, making them difficult to distinguish using only two genes. The dataset also contains substantially more brain samples, which may influence the model's predictions. Overall, these results suggest that classifying seven organs is more challenging than distinguishing only lung and breast tissues, and additional genes may improve the model's performance."

        "### Final Reflection\n",
        "\n",
        "**1. How does binary classification differ from multi-class classification?**\n",
        "\n",
        "Binary classification involves predicting between two different categories, such as lung and breast tissues. Multi-class classification involves predicting between more than two categories, such as the seven different organs used in this activity. Multi-class classification can be more challenging because the model must distinguish between several different tissue types.\n",
        "\n",
        "**2. What does a confusion matrix reveal in multi-class settings?**\n",
        "\n",
        "A confusion matrix shows how many samples were correctly and incorrectly classified for each organ. It also helps identify which organs are frequently confused with one another. In this activity, the model frequently misclassified breast, liver, and ovary samples as brain tissue.\n",
        "\n",
        "**3. Why might some tissues be harder to classify?**\n",
        "\n",
        "Some tissues may have similar integrin gene expression levels, making it difficult for the model to distinguish between them. Using only two integrin genes may not provide enough information to accurately identify all seven organs. Differences in sample sizes may also affect the model's performance.\n",
        "\n",
        "**4. Does classification performance imply biological causation?**\n",
        "\n",
        "No, classification performance does not necessarily imply biological causation. Even if a gene is useful for predicting tissue type, that does not mean the gene directly causes the biological differences between those tissues. The model identifies patterns and associations in the data rather than establishing cause-and-effect relationships."
